AZA · Dussey Caleb Semekor · Andam-Cobbold Paapa Kobbina

Same system. Four different arguments.

AZA is a mobile-first payments platform for Ghana — one ledger carrying a wallet, a chat, a merchant rail, an agent cash network and a developer platform. Pick who is in the room, and how long you have.

Every figure in all four decks is drawn from the repository and the internal strategy documents, and each is dated. Nothing here is a projection presented as a measurement.
